digest.component_or_area: reconciler committed cache and tickets branch repository
propositions: The tickets branch is 1.04 GiB, with 92% consumed by the reconciler's committed .bridge_state cache due to scattered edits in a sort-ordered 18 MB bindings.json file that defeats git delta compression, measured at 12.79 KB marginal cost per version across 40 consecutive revisions.

Baseline_advanced_at field is written at binding_store.py:375 but read nowhere in src/, changing 1144 times per pass and responsible for 7.4x of the compression overhead; removing it reduces marginal cost to 1.74 KB per version.

Last_get_pass rotation bookkeeping field causes 20 changes per pass and must be moved to a separate .bridge_state/get_rotation.json file to halve version count and reduce total marginal cost by 12.8x combined.

The one-time historical reclaim using git fast-export filter pipeline reduces the real branch from 1,172,586,762 to 98,803,422 bytes (8.4%) while preserving all 49,888 commits and 2,661 merges and maintaining byte-identical HEAD tree after dynamic re-add.

Rollout requires descendant reconciler workflow execution proof, explicit host refresh, mixed-version self-healing oracle, live epoch-refusal probes at both union sites, and operator-attested quiescence before reclaim publication with verified off-repo backup bundle.
